low_fire.name: low fire
low_fire.inspectText: Embers settle and brighten in their own time. The fire is small, not dying.

hearth_cushion.name: velvet cushion
hearth_cushion.inspectText: Worn just enough to prove somebody has rested here before.

blue_flower.name: pressed blue flower
blue_flower.inspectText: A small blue flower, already pressed flat. No label explains where it came from.

empty_frame.name: empty frame
empty_frame.inspectText: The frame is beautifully made. Its emptiness feels intentional rather than unfinished.

tall_mirror.name: tall mirror
tall_mirror.inspectText: Your reflection keeps perfect time. The darkness behind it does not.
